description: Tropical geometry replaces algebraic operations with (max,+) semiring and has been used to study amoebas of complex varieties. The amoeba of the discriminant locus of univalent polynomials has a tropical limit whose geometry constrains the feasible region for extremal functions.
mathematical_formalization: For f(z) = z + a_2z^2 + ... + a_Nz^N, the discriminant Δ_f = Res(f', f-w). The amoeba A(Δ_f) = {(log|a_k|, log|w|) : Δ_f = 0}. The tropical limit trop(Δ_f) approximates A(Δ_f).
implementation_hypothesis: Compute Newton polytope of discriminant for degree-N univalent polynomials. Use polymake/Gfan for tropical variety. Identify regions where covering radius is maximized.
experiment_seed: For N=4, compute discriminant explicitly. Compute Newton polytope and tropical variety. Visualize amoeba numerically.
